ns2:section.sectionText: NFO 220-12, Resources and Information Services in Medical Librarianship, will offer contemporary knowledge and skills on topics such as health sciences library history, medical subject classification, finding quality health information, biomedical database practice, consumer health programming, evidence-based health care, and cooperative medical library organizations and activities. Collaborative learning and assignments are featured. Class Disclaimer: Students must meet the school's home computing and technology literacy prerequisites. See http://ischool.sjsu.edu/current-students/technology-support/home-computing-environmentA WISE course; requires consent of Graduate Studies Advisor to enroll (klucht@illinois.edu). Meets asynchronously through San Jose State University, INFO 220-12, Aug. 21 - Dec. 10, 2018. The instructor is Charles Greenberg.
